svg.title: bulkformer-latest architecture
svg.desc: Natural ln(TPM+1) expression over 19,973 genes is encoded with normalized gene identity embeddings and scaled sinusoidal expression features. A weighted GCN and 12 Performer layers produce sample features, contextual gene features, and expression predictions. The model has 101.3 million parameters and 768 hidden channels.
